snapshots.notes: Frozen local snapshot of the IANA Language Subtag Registry and license evidence. The public endpoints are mutable, so checksum-pinned regeneration uses these retained inputs.
Pinned local snapshot of selected Unicode 17.0.0 UCD files, including auxiliary segmentation and general category property files.
Pinned local snapshot of selected cldr-core supplemental JSON files.
Pinned official CAMeL Morph MSA release database.
Pinned Arabic WordNet v4.1.0 WN-LMF XML release with license, notice, citation, README, and upstream validation report.

Co-located but independent evidence: pinned checksum sidecars for the Wikidata 2026-06-08 full JSON entity dump, plus deterministic gzip-compressed Arabic, English, and French core extracts retrieved independently from Wikidata Query Service on 2026-06-12. The query-service extracts are not claimed to derive from the full dump; the full raw dump remains artifact-backed.
